sets.name: LEIBHOLZ
sets.dek: Eight households of one surname, seven of them in one city and the eighth in Melbourne. Two of them are separated from ours by sixty-two days and no longer by place; one of them begins in the same Kreis our own great-great-grandfather was born in. ***UPDATED 22 SEPTEMBER 2026:*** the 1874 Szubin marriage entry has been read, and it puts OUR OWN LINE AT HAMMERSTEIN — born there, living there, and marrying out of it — while naming a generation above Sally that nobody had. The lanes stay apart because no document joins them. The REASON for expecting them apart has gone.

sets.name: LUWINSKI
sets.dek: Two of these lanes were found on 20 September, and only because the search was run on every spelling. The same East Prussian registry writes one woman LOWINSKI in four years and LUWINSKI in two. One more was found later the same day, in a South African gazette, and it is here to be kept out.
